mapper.insert: insert into xl_like (user_id, target_type, target_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from xl_like where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from xl_like where target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
select id, user_id, target_type, target_id, create_time from xl_like where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId} limit 1
